en.quote: …raise life expectancy to 78 years (and to 80 by 2030).
en.head: Life expectancy was 72.84 years in 2024.
en.body: Rosstat’s preliminary annual figure for 2024 was 72.84 years, below the 78-year target. A new 2024 decree moved the 78-year goal to 2030. This uses a calendar-year figure rather than a rolling twelve-month estimate.
en.meta_context: Decree No. 204, “On National Goals and Strategic Objectives…”
